whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Bonkers Cakery,

I noticed your bakery has strong 4.5★ reviews in the Fraser Road area near Maurya Lok, but currently lacks a dedicated mobile website for custom cake orders and menu inquiries.

Maine aapke bakery ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp cake booking, signature menu, aur gallery integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/bonkerscakery

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Bonkers Cakery team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp cake ordering and a showcase of your custom creations right near Maurya Lok. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact cake varieties, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
